title: Opaque dialogs + stronger Product Editor workspace surface styling

requirements.summary: Make onboarding instructions modal fully opaque by removing forced popover backgrounds and applying an opaque surface with consistent border/shadow.
acceptanceCriteria: When opening the onboarding instructions modal, the dialog surface is fully opaque (no translucency/see-through effect) in both light and dark themes.
The modal remains readable with clear contrast between background and text.
Scroll behavior and responsive sizing remain intact (modal content is still scrollable; no content is cut off on phone/tablet/desktop).
No `!bg-popover` overrides remain on the onboarding modal container/header/content/footer that could reintroduce transparency.

file_operations.description: Remove all `!bg-popover` class overrides from DialogContent, DialogHeader, scroll container, and DialogFooter; apply an explicitly opaque surface background (e.g., `bg-card text-card-foreground`) and consistent `border`/`shadow` utilities so the modal is never translucent while keeping existing sizing and scroll behavior unchanged.

requirements.summary: Make Profile Setup dialog match the same opaque, readable dialog styling as onboarding by removing forced popover backgrounds and using an opaque surface with consistent border/shadow.
acceptanceCriteria: When the Profile Setup dialog is shown, the dialog surface is fully opaque (no translucency) in both light and dark themes.
The dialog content (title, description, input, buttons) is clearly legible with sufficient contrast.
The dialog’s existing behavior (cannot dismiss by clicking outside, form submission) remains unchanged.

file_operations.description: Remove `!bg-popover` overrides from DialogContent/DialogHeader/body/DialogFooter; apply the same opaque surface styling used for onboarding (e.g., `bg-card text-card-foreground` with consistent `border`/`shadow`) while preserving current outside-click prevention and submit behavior.

requirements.summary: Strengthen Product Editor workspace surface styling with a visible subtle tint/gradient and softened borders/shadows without changing functionality.
acceptanceCriteria: The Product Editor workspace area has a visibly tinted/gradient surface (not plain white) in light theme and retains appropriate depth/contrast in dark theme.
Borders and shadows appear softened (no harsh stark outlines), while maintaining clear separation between sections.
All existing Product Editor functionality remains unchanged (editing, tabs, Generate, Generate All Products, error display).

file_operations.description: Adjust the workspace container surface styling to be more visibly tinted/gradient-based (using existing theme tokens such as `background/muted/accent/primary`) and refine border/shadow treatment to appear softer while keeping layout, spacing, and all generation/navigation logic unchanged.
If needed for consistent depth and separation within the strengthened workspace, lightly soften internal editor Card borders/shadows using existing theme tokens (no layout or behavioral changes).

requirements.summary: Add a subtle, always-rendered styling-only tweak inside the Product Editor workspace container as a deterministic deployment sanity check.
acceptanceCriteria: After deployment, there is at least one subtle but clearly observable visual change in the editor workspace container styling that can be used to confirm the new build is running.
The tweak does not add new UI features, buttons, or flows; it is purely a styling-level change.
No functional behavior changes occur in the editor view.

file_operations.description: Add a small, styling-only utility/class (scoped to the Product Editor workspace container) that creates a subtle but noticeable visual signature (e.g., a faint top accent highlight/outline or micro-gradient) using existing theme tokens; ensure it does not affect layout or introduce new interactive UI.

Apply the new workspace sanity-check class/utility to the always-rendered workspace container so the signature is consistently visible on every load without adding new UI elements or changing any behavior.

requirements.summary: Update onboarding instructions modal header/title to match current neutral branding used in the app header (English-only).
acceptanceCriteria: The onboarding modal title does not say “Automation Product Pack!” and instead uses the current app branding consistent with the header title.

file_operations.description: Update the DialogTitle copy to match the header branding (use the same product name shown in the header: “Digital Bundle Studio”) and ensure the title remains English-only.
